name: Byclaw Wiki
description: Clone requested Git repositories on demand, index them with CodeGraph for fast source analysis, and generate/read Zread Wiki output.

dataDir.description: Plugin data directory. Defaults to OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR/byclaw-wiki.

codegraphCommand.description: CodeGraph executable used for indexing and code analysis.

zreadCommand.description: Zread CLI executable used by wiki_* modes.

zreadHome.description: Service-level HOME directory used when running zread. Defaults to <dataDir>/zread-home.

commandTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for Git and CodeGraph commands.

maxOutputBytes.description: Maximum stdout/stderr bytes captured per Git or CodeGraph command stream.

zreadMaxOutputBytes.description: Maximum stdout/stderr bytes captured per Zread command stream.

redisHost.description: Redis host for resolving Baiying AI model config. Defaults to REDIS_HOST.

redisPort.description: Redis port. Defaults to REDIS_PORT or 6379.

redisDatabase.description: Redis database. Defaults to REDIS_DATABASE, REDIS_DB, or 0.

redisConnectTimeoutMs.description: Redis connection timeout for Zread model resolution.

zreadAimodelEnabled.description: Resolve the Zread LLM config from Baiying Redis AI model config before wiki_* operations.

zreadAimodelConfigRedisKey.description: Redis Hash key for Baiying AI model config.

zreadAimodelTypeListRedisKey.description: Redis Hash key for Baiying AI model type list.

zreadAimodelTypeListField.description: Redis typelist field used to select the default Zread LLM.

zreadAimodelModelId.description: Optional explicit Baiying model id. When unset, the LLM typelist default is used.

zreadAimodelProvider.description: Optional Zread provider override. Defaults to instanceParam.zreadProvider or openai.

zreadLlmProvider.description: Fallback Zread LLM provider used when Redis model resolution fails.

zreadLlmModel.description: Fallback Zread LLM model used when Redis model resolution fails.

zreadLlmBaseUrl.description: Fallback Zread LLM base URL used when Redis model resolution fails.

zreadLlmApiKey.description: Fallback Zread LLM API key. Prefer zreadLlmApiKeyEnv when possible.

zreadLlmApiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable name containing the fallback Zread LLM API key.

includeRawOutputInToolResult.description: Whether code_to_wiki returns raw CodeGraph/Zread output to OpenClaw.

gitDepth.description: Default Git clone/fetch depth. Default 1 keeps only the latest commit.
